source.quote: Denafrips manuals and reviews across the range, read 2026-11-20: USB and I2S decode to 24-bit/1536 kHz PCM and DSD1024; coaxial, optical and AES/EBU top out at 24-bit/192 kHz with DoP DSD64. Consistent for the Pontus II, Venus and Terminator; the figures for the first-generation Pontus were not found and are assumed to follow.
